svg.title: WPB Archive Dashboard
svg.desc: Integrated dashboard of the Weronika Pérez Borjas research archive: corpus size, editorial phases, metadata coverage, publication timeline, research pipeline and portfolio readiness.
svg.text: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH · CORPUS.JSON · ARTICLE-METADATA.JSON · CREDITS.JSON
One coordinated view of the reconstructed archive: what has been found, how the work develops,
how complete the metadata is, and what remains before the archive can become a public portfolio.
All quantitative visuals are regenerated from canonical repository data.
Each curve is one verified work. The four bundles are analytical phases, not self-declared career labels.
